sentence: A GPT earns the label because it makes "new and complementary production methods" available, which can raise output over time
passage: [Czarnitzki et al. (2023), p. 188] "The main feature of general-purpose technology is to enable new and complementary production methods that may increase productivity over time (Bresnahan and Trajtenberg 1995; Bresnahan et al., 2002; Brynjolfsson and Hitt 2003; Cardona et al., 2013)."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately paraphrases the passage, capturing the main feature of a general-purpose technology and reasonably equating increased productivity with raised output.
